home.gearIntro: Explore the gear behind a pop-up portrait setup. Choose a category to find the pieces that fit the way you shoot.
home.setupHeadline:
It’s a tent.
Until it’s a studio.
home.setupDescription: The real setup is part gear, part scene-building, and part making the most of the space you have. These photos come from the Tent Boy setup itself.

categories.name: Canopy / structure
categories.description: Give your portrait space a home base. Plan for the frame, sidewalls and secure anchoring your location requires.

categories.name: Backdrops / flooring
categories.description: Build a world behind your subject. Think about backdrop size, how it hangs, and what happens at ground level. Setup photo shown for context; it does not identify the linked stand.

categories.name: Lighting / power
categories.description: Make room for lights, modifiers and a power plan. Match the equipment to the conditions where you work. Setup photo shown for context; it does not identify the linked stands.

categories.name: Camera / lenses
categories.description: Choose a camera and lens pairing that works within the tent’s shooting distance. Check compatibility before you buy.

categories.name: Accessories
categories.description: Clips, cases and thoughtful details help pull a setup together. Leave room on the list for the small essentials. Setup photo shown for context; the linked Shutter Huggers are not pictured.
